caption: The drawing depicts two views of the same figurine, both standing on a gray stone-like rectangular base. The figurine is of a woman with a light beige complexion and straight black hair covered partially by a hood or shawl. She has black, arched eyebrows, black eyes, a pointed nose, and red lips. The woman is dressed in a long, black dress with long sleeves, and the front of her dress is adorned with a vertical row of red dots. She has multiple red bead-like bracelets on her wrists. Around her waist, there is a pink sash tied in a knot, with its ends hanging down. Both of her hands are held together in front of her chest, and her fingers are distinct. The background is a plain, off-white color, and both the frontal and three-quarters rear views of the figure are shown. In the bottom right corner, the text "VIRGIL G. CHAPIN - TAOS" appears.
title: Bulto, Santa Rita
